title: Law to help city workers start employee resource groups
summary: This bill would require the Department of Citywide Administrative Services to assess existing employee resource groups at city agencies and mayoral offices every five years, including outreach to at least five group organizers and a citywide employee survey. The department would then issue guidance on how employees can start their own groups and publish an annually updated list of existing groups with organizer contact information. The law would take effect 60 days after enactment.
